audit.why: Favoured for Malzahar around 6 and first item (R cancels Death Lotus and locks her resets); early levels and late game are skill/execution. Prose reflects this; the full-layer chart did not.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart had Malzahar on all 7 rows at 7-8/10; content win[] and the packet both say Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Malzahar/Malzahar/Skill.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and content agree exactly; the full layer was a blanket template. Moved rows 0-3 and 6 to Skill and rewrote the whys to match; rows 4-5 (post-6 and first item, Malzahar) already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood told the player to 'poke his shield off' — Katarina has no shield; the string is the Kassadin template pasted in. breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and named a fabricated passive 'Iron Boundary'. Eighteen fields misgendered Katarina as he/him.
audit.why: Kit: Shunpo 12-8s (drops only via Voracity kill resets), Death Lotus 75/60/45s and is a channel — Malzahar's Q silence (6s CD) or R suppression cancels it; Bouncing Blade is a projectile and grounds dashes on its dagger zone is false (grounding flag is on her Q per parser — Riot's text says nothing about grounding, so it was not written to the page). Void Shift eats her opening burst.
audit.corrected: Trades rewritten around silence-vs-Shunpo, real cooldowns written in, pronouns fixed everywhere lint flagged.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Silence-and-sting: land E, then hold Q for her Shunpo — the silence stops her reset chain mid-combo and the voidlings chase her out of the fight.

edits.after: Trading with Void Shift on cooldown — her Shunpo burst deletes the squishiest scaling mage in the pool once your passive is gone.

edits.before: - Katarina Shunpo: matchup-defining — Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget spell shield (Iron Boundary) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Shunpo is 12s at rank 1 and only drops early through kill resets — step up in its downtime, never into it. - Death Lotus runs 75/60/45s and is a channel: your 6s-cooldown Q silence or your R suppression cancels it outright. - Save the 140s R for her commit, not for poke.

edits.before: Best wave: a permanently crashing E-W shove — his tower bleeds plates, his roams cost waves, and your visions did all the work. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with no voidlings up — walking to it is the only time Malzahar is ever actually alone. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
